title: andropogon sorghum subsp. effusus
intro: Andropogon sorghum subsp. effusus, commonly known as broom sorghum or sweet sorghum, is a type of grass native to tropical Asia. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and provide antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Andropogon sorghum subsp. effusus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
